name: St. Marc Café

gf.detail: No gluten-free FOOD, and the clearest 'no' of the four. The chain exists to sell the チョコクロ (chocolate croissant); the サンド, パン, パスタ and ドリア categories are wheat end to end. Filtering Saint Marc's own allergen tool for items containing no wheat/egg/dairy/shrimp/crab/beef/salmon/mackerel/chicken/pork/gelatin returns 55 results, and every one is a drink, an alcohol, a sugar or a retail item — except a single food, はちみつそらまめ (honey-coated broad beans). Their table carries the standard hedge 「器具等の共有により他の特定原材料が微量混入するおそれがあります」. Not a celiac food option.

vegan.best: — (black coffee, tea, ゆず茶 or apple juice only)
vegan.detail: The one chain here that fails a vegan outright. Saint Marc Café stocks NO plant milk of ANY kind: their complete allergen table (カフェメニュー別 カロリー・栄養成分・アレルゲン一覧表, last updated 2026-08-21) contains zero occurrences of 豆乳, オーツミルク or アーモンドミルク, and every カフェラテ, ロイヤルミルクティー, ほうじ茶ラテ, 抹茶ラテ and キャラメルマキアート is dairy. There is no soy option, no swap, and no surcharge to pay — it simply does not exist. There is also no plant-based food: of the 55 animal-allergen-free items the only edible one, はちみつそらまめ, contains HONEY. What is left for a vegan is サンマルクブレンド / アメリカン (black coffee), 紅茶 / べにふうき和紅茶 (black tea), ゆず茶, and アップルジュース. Treat this chain as a place to sit, not a place to eat or to get a latte.

both_gf_and_vegan: NO. No GF food and no vegan food. The only wheat-free food in the entire catalogue, はちみつそらまめ, contains honey.
caveats: NO plant milk at all — no soy, no oat, no almond. Every latte / au lait / milk tea is dairy
The only animal-allergen-free FOOD in the whole catalogue, はちみつそらまめ, contains honey
Signature チョコクロ = wheat + dairy + egg
TRAP: クラムチャウダー is listed under ホットドリンク — it is a shellfish soup, not a drink
Dessert and smoothie range is dairy-heavy (練乳, ハーゲンダッツ, チーズケーキ風クリーム)
Allergen data excludes cross-contamination: 「器具等の共有により他の特定原材料が微量混入するおそれがあります」
